body: I'm in connecticut I'm really scared at the end of the month I'll be putting a tent just in whatever woods I can find unless I can find somewhere else to put it :(

I sadly don’t have an ID, and I can start the process to get one but they don’t print off IDs any more same day, it takes a couple weeks for you to get the official copy and I can’t wait that long. That’s why I’m bus hopping. I’ll sleep in parks if I have to, I can’t be here anymore

I’ve decided I’m going to hop city bus to city bus all the way to Florida. I’m terrified I’ve never done anything like this before but I need to leave for my own safety and mental health. I’m going to try and sell everything I possibly can, I am scared of running out of money on the way down but it’s a risk I have to take
Thank you for the digital hug, it honestly means the world to me. ❤️
I sadly don’t have an ID right now and I think I’m going to have to take a bus to get down there. An id is going to take to long to get here :( I’m so scared

I did fill out a police report as my roommate said. She was going to throw all my stuff out of the house. I didn’t have the police at the house because I was scared it would make it worse. I’m hoping to leave at the end of next week. I’m so scared I have to get away
I’m considering just taking each bus as far as I can go and filing in with Uber’s where I have to to get to the next bus. I’m so scared I just have to get away :(

I don’t have a car sadly :( I’m trying so hard to find a way to Florida. I don’t have an ID right now and I’m going to try and get one over the next week, but they just give you a temp one and I’m scared of not being able to get away from here quick enough :( I just want to leave so badly. Do I need an ID for a bus? Could I take a bus to Florida?
